metadata.noGraph: Basic image information is available. Generation parameters require a saved execution graph.

tips.positive: Text describing the desired image. Its influence also depends on CFG, Guidance and the model.
tips.negative: Text describing what to avoid, when the sampler actually uses negative conditioning.
tips.system_prompt: Instructions telling the text encoder model how to interpret the prompt.
tips.unassigned: Saved text whose consuming generation step and positive or negative role cannot be determined.
tips.conditioning: Prompts are encoded into numeric features. Zeroing removes those text features; the connection and other conditioning data may remain.
tips.model: The main image generation model. Merged models retain the participating resources.
tips.clip: Converts text into features used by the model. Examples include CLIP, T5 and Qwen.
tips.vae: VAE converts between pixel images and latent representations. The value identifies its file or providing checkpoint.
tips.lora: LoRA adapts model style or capabilities. Model and text encoder strengths apply separately; repeated applications retain their order.
tips.model_settings: Model loading, merging or runtime settings. Expand sources to inspect the node and field.
tips.seed: Random seed of the sampling node, not necessarily an independently reproducible seed for one image in a batch.
tips.steps: Configured sampling steps. Partial sampling, denoise and sigma splitting can change the steps used by this stage.
tips.stage_steps: Steps determined from saved sigma settings or the sampling range, not model evaluation count or elapsed time.
tips.sampler: The algorithm that updates the image during sampling, such as Euler or DPM++.
tips.scheduler: Controls noise levels across sampling steps, such as simple or karras.
tips.cfg: Classifier-Free Guidance compares positive and negative conditioning. Larger values usually impose stronger guidance; the useful range depends on the model.
tips.guidance: A guidance value sent directly to models such as Flux. This differs from sampler CFG and is model specific.
tips.denoise: Controls how much of the denoising process is used. Lower values often preserve more of an input image; 1 usually uses the full process.
tips.start_at_step: Position in the noise schedule where this stage begins, rather than its step count.
tips.end_at_step: Position where this stage ends, usually clamped to the configured schedule length.
tips.add_noise: Whether to add random noise at the start of this stage. Continuation stages may reuse their incoming state.
tips.return_with_leftover_noise: Whether to retain remaining noise for a later sampling stage.
tips.sampling_settings: Additional saved sampler or noise settings. Expand sources to inspect the node and field.
tips.width: Pixel width represented by the image or latent input of this stage; it may differ from the saved image.
tips.height: Pixel height represented by the image or latent input of this stage; it may differ from the saved image.
tips.batch_size: Configured images per batch at this step, not necessarily the number of saved files.
tips.controlnet: Provides additional guidance such as pose, edges or depth alongside text prompts.
tips.control_settings: Control strength, type or active range. Start and end fractions usually range from 0 to 1.
tips.upscale_model: Model used to enlarge images or restore detail. Its filename alone cannot determine the output size.
tips.upscale_method: Interpolation algorithm used to resize pixels or latents, such as bilinear or bicubic.
tips.scale_by: Size multiplier. A value of 2 doubles both width and height.
tips.target_width: Requested output width; aspect-ratio and rounding rules may affect the resulting size.
tips.target_height: Requested output height; aspect-ratio and rounding rules may affect the resulting size.
tips.grow_mask_by: Pixels by which the inpainting mask expands to include surrounding edges.
tips.noise_mask: Limits noise or inpainting to masked regions; exact behavior depends on the source node.
tips.processing_settings: Additional resize, crop, mask or inpainting settings. Expand sources for the operation.

fieldTips.weight_dtype: Numeric precision used to load weights, affecting memory and computation. The default is chosen by the loader and the final precision may not be saved.
fieldTips.device: Device selected for the model or encoder. The default depends on the node and ComfyUI device settings.
fieldTips.type: Model architecture or encoding mode selected by the loader to interpret the weights.
